title: Corner C3 - Mobile Layout Wireframes
summary: All 3 modes at 390px width. Bottom sheet, PWA icon, splash screen. Touch interactions. iPhone-first.
content:
Corner C3: Mobile Layout Wireframes

Steffen | 2026-03-16 For Bobby. iPhone 14 Pro (390px) is the target. Everything must work at this width. Contractors check Corner on their phone at job sites.

Mobile Chrome (All Modes)

Fixed Elements

+------------------------------------------+  0px
|  CORNER.  [mode icon]           [HUD v]  |  <- 44px HUD bar (slimmer than desktop 48px)
+------------------------------------------+  44px
|                                          |
|                                          |
|        M O D E   C O N T E N T          |
|                                          |
|                                          |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+  calc(100vh - 100px)
| [Game]     [Checklist]     [Megaboard]   |  <- 44px mode tab bar
+------------------------------------------+  calc(100vh - 56px)
| [Avatar] [Message Bobby...]      [Send]  |  <- 56px chat bar
+------------------------------------------+  100vh

Top HUD Bar (Mobile, 44px)

  • Height: 44px (4px slimmer than desktop)
  • Left: CORNER. logo (Syne 800, 14px)
  • Center: current mode name (Space Grotesk 500, 11px, #6B7280, optional, can omit)
  • Right: HUD expand chevron (ChevronDown, 14px)
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.92) (slightly more opaque on mobile for thumb readability)
  • Backdrop-filter: blur(16px)

Mode Tab Bar (Mobile, 44px)

See c3-mode-switcher-spec.md for details. Summary:

  • Icons only, no labels
  • 20px Lucide icons
  • Active: #E85D26 + 4px dot below
  • Equal-width thirds
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.95)
  • Safe area: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding

Chat Bar (Mobile, 56px)

  • Same as desktop but:
    • Agent avatar: 28px (slightly smaller)
    • Send button: 32px
    • Input text: 14px
    • Padding: 0 12px (tighter horizontal)

Total Bottom Area

  • Mode tab bar: 44px
  • Chat bar: 56px
  • Safe area inset: ~34px on iPhone (notch models)
  • Total: 134px from bottom edge on iPhone with notch
  • Content area: 100vh - 44px (top) - 100px (bottom) = ~622px on iPhone 14 Pro (844px screen)

Game Mode (Mobile)

Layout

  • Full-screen isometric view
  • Takes up the entire content area (622px height)
  • No HUD drawer (too cramped). HUD accessible via expand chevron only.

Touch Interactions

  • Tap room: Zoom to Level 2, camera centers on room, agent detail bottom sheet appears
  • Double-tap room: Zoom to Level 3
  • Tap empty space: Zoom back to Level 1 (overview), dismiss bottom sheet
  • Pinch to zoom: Continuous zoom (0.5x - 3.5x)
  • One-finger drag: Pan when zoomed (Level 2 or 3)
  • Momentum: Pan continues with deceleration on finger release

Agent Detail Bottom Sheet

When the user taps a room at Level 2:

+------------------------------------------+
|                                          |
|          I S O M E T R I C              |
|             V I E W                      |
|         (room zoomed in)                 |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+
|          [drag handle]                    |  <- bottom sheet (peek height)
|                                          |
|  [Avatar 40px]  Bobby                    |
|                 Web Dev                   |
|                 ACTIVE  2h ago            |
|                                          |
|  Current: Rebuild /v2 to audit standard  |
|                                          |
|  [Chat with Bobby]  [View Tasks]         |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Game]     [Checklist]     [Megaboard]   |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Avatar] [Message Bobby...]      [Send]  |
+------------------------------------------+

Bottom Sheet Specs:

  • Peek height: 200px (shows agent identity + current task + buttons)
  • Full height: 60vh (swipe up to see recent completions, vitals)
  • Drag handle: centered, 40px wide, 4px tall, rgba(255,255,255,0.15), border-radius 2px
  • Background: rgba(10, 15, 30, 0.98)
  • Border-top: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08)
  • Border-radius: 16px 16px 0 0 (top corners rounded)
  • Shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4)
  • Swipe down: dismisses the sheet + zooms back to Level 1
  • Swipe up: expands to full 60vh height

Sheet Contents (Peek):

  • Agent avatar (SpriteAvatar, 40px, agentColor border)
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 700, 18px, #FDF6EC
  • Agent role: JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, #6B7280, uppercase
  • Status pill: same as everywhere
  • Current task: Space Grotesk 400, 14px, #F0ECE6, 2 lines max
  • Two buttons (flex row, equal width, 12px gap):
    • "Chat with [Agent]" -- opens full-screen chat
    • "View Tasks" -- switches to Checklist mode with this agent selected

Sheet Contents (Expanded to 60vh):

  • Everything from Peek +
  • Separator line
  • "Recent" section header
  • Last 5 completed tasks (same as Megaboard agent deep-dive recent completions)
  • HP bar (utilization %)

Button Specs:

  • Height: 44px (touch-friendly)
  • Border-radius: 8px
  • Font: Space Grotesk 600, 13px
  • "Chat" button: background agentColor at 15%, text agentColor, border 1px solid agentColor at 25%
  • "View Tasks" button: background rgba(255,255,255,0.04), text #F0ECE6, border 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08)

Checklist Mode (Mobile)

Layout

+------------------------------------------+
|  CORNER.                           [HUD v]|
+------------------------------------------+
| [All] [Mom] [Bobby*] [Steffen] [Alex] >> |  <- 56px horizontal scroll
+------------------------------------------+
|                                          |
|  [Avatar 32px]  Bobby                    |
|                 Web Dev   ACTIVE          |
|                                          |
|  [=] [x] Rebuild /v2 to audit standard  |
|       ACTIVE  2h ago                     |
|                                          |
|  [=] [ ] Fix shared nav footer bugs     |
|       QUEUED                             |
|                                          |
|  [=] [ ] Optimize room image sizes      |
|       QUEUED                             |
|                                          |
|  ------- Done (3) -------               |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Add a task for Bobby...]                |  <- add task input
+------------------------------------------+
| [Game]     [CHECKLIST]     [Megaboard]   |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Avatar] [Message Bobby...]      [Send]  |
+------------------------------------------+

Agent Scroll Bar

  • Height: 56px
  • Horizontal scroll with chips (see c3-checklist-mode-spec.md for chip design)
  • Scroll-snap-type: x mandatory
  • Active chip: agentColor accent
  • Scrollable with momentum

Task List

  • Full width, 16px horizontal padding
  • Task cards: same design as desktop but full-width
  • Drag handle: always visible (no hover on touch)
  • Long-press (150ms) initiates drag
  • Touch drag to reorder (use @dnd-kit touch sensors)

Add Task Input

  • Fixed above mode tab bar
  • Height: 48px (large touch target)
  • Keyboard avoidance: use visualViewport API to push content up when keyboard opens
  • When keyboard is open: mode tab bar and chat bar hide (keyboard takes their space)

Megaboard Mode (Mobile)

Layout

+------------------------------------------+
|  CORNER.                           [HUD v]|
+------------------------------------------+
|                                          |
|  PARTY                                   |
| +--------+ +--------+ +--------+        |
| | Bobby  | | Steffen| | Alex   |  >>    |
| | LV 7   | | LV 5   | | LV 4   |       |
| | HP 85% | | HP 60% | | HP 45% |        |
| +--------+ +--------+ +--------+        |
|                                          |
|  QUEST LOG                          [v]  |
|  [Avatar] Rebuild /v2...    ACTIVE       |
|  [Avatar] Brand page v4... QUEUED        |
|  [Avatar] Fix /briefs...   QUEUED        |
|  Show all (12)                           |
|                                          |
|  MISSION FEED                       [v]  |
|  (collapsed by default on mobile)        |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Game]     [Checklist]     [MEGABOARD]   |
+------------------------------------------+
| [Avatar] [Message Bobby...]      [Send]  |
+------------------------------------------+

Party Screen (Horizontal Scroll)

  • Cards: 140px wide, 120px tall
  • Horizontal scroll, scroll-snap
  • Show ~2.5 cards (peek the next card)
  • Same card design as desktop but compressed:
    • Avatar: 28px
    • Name: 14px
    • Level: 10px
    • HP bar: 6px height (slimmer)
    • Quest text: 11px, 1 line

Quest Log (Collapsible)

  • Default: expanded, showing top 5 quests
  • Chevron to collapse (saves vertical space)
  • "Show all (N)" link at bottom
  • Full-width quest items

Mission Feed (Collapsible)

  • Default: collapsed (save space)
  • Header shows "MISSION FEED" + event count badge
  • When expanded: last 10 events, same design as desktop but full-width
  • Collapsed height: just the header (32px)

Tap to Expand

  • Tap a Party Screen card: scrolls down to show that agent's deep-dive (inline, replaces Party Screen section)
  • Back arrow to return to Party Screen grid

Full-Screen Chat (Mobile)

When the user taps the chat bar or opens chat from the bottom sheet:

+------------------------------------------+
|  [<]  Bobby  ACTIVE                      |  <- 48px header
+------------------------------------------+
|                                          |
|  Agent message bubble                     |
|                                          |
|             User message bubble           |
|                                          |
|  Agent message bubble                     |
|  (streaming word-by-word...)             |
|                                          |
|  [typing indicator...]                   |
|                                          |
+------------------------------------------+
| [+] [Message Bobby.................] [>] |  <- 56px input bar
+------------------------------------------+

Key differences from desktop:

  • Chat takes 100vh (full screen). No 40% intermediate on mobile.
  • Back arrow ([<]) in top-left returns to previous mode/view
  • Swipe right from left edge also dismisses chat (gesture)
  • No game world visible behind the chat
  • Message bubbles: max-width 85% (wider than desktop's 75%)
  • Input bar respects keyboard (pushes up, content scrolls)

Header:

  • Height: 48px
  • Back arrow: ArrowLeft, 18px, #6B7280, tap target 44px
  • Agent avatar: SpriteAvatar, 28px
  • Agent name: Space Grotesk 600, 15px, #FDF6EC
  • Status: Space Grotesk 400, 11px, agentColor

Input Bar:

  • Height: 56px
  • Attachment button: Paperclip, 16px, #6B7280 (future feature, can be hidden for C3)
  • Input: flex 1, 40px height, 14px font
  • Send: 36px circle, agentColor background
  • Safe area: env(safe-area-inset-bottom) padding at the very bottom

PWA Specifications

Manifest

{
  "name": "Corner",
  "short_name": "Corner",
  "description": "Your AI team, visible and alive.",
  "display": "standalone",
  "orientation": "portrait",
  "background_color": "#0A0F1E",
  "theme_color": "#0A0F1E",
  "start_url": "/app",
  "scope": "/app",
  "icons": [
    { "src": "/corner/pwa-icon-192.png", "sizes": "192x192", "type": "image/png" },
    { "src": "/corner/pwa-icon-512.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png" },
    { "src": "/corner/pwa-icon-maskable.png", "sizes": "512x512", "type": "image/png", "purpose": "maskable" }
  ]
}

App Icon (Steffen to design)

  • Shape: the letter "C" stylized as an isometric room corner
  • Or: the CORNER wordmark compressed into a square
  • Color: #E85D26 (orange) on #0A0F1E (dark navy) background
  • Maskable version: icon centered in safe zone (80% of canvas)
  • Sizes needed: 192x192, 512x512, 180x180 (apple-touch-icon)

Splash Screen

  • Background: #0A0F1E
  • Center: CORNER. wordmark (Syne 800, white with orange dot)
  • Below: "Loading your office..." in Space Grotesk 400, 13px, #6B7280
  • Below that: subtle loading spinner (3 dots pulsing in orange, same as typing indicator)
  • Duration: show until first data paint (status API response)

Offline Status View

When the WebSocket disconnects and the app is offline:

  • Top banner: "Reconnecting..." in JetBrains Mono 500, 10px, #F59E0B on rgba(245,158,11,0.08) background
  • Banner height: 28px, slides down from top
  • Content: show last-known agent states (cached in localStorage)
  • Agents show their last known status with stale timestamp
  • No interactive features (can't send messages, can't drag tasks)
  • When reconnected: banner slides up, data refreshes, normal operation resumes

Touch Targets

All interactive elements on mobile must meet minimum 44x44px touch targets:

Element Min Touch Target Visual Size
Mode tab 44x44px 20px icon
Agent chip (Checklist) 44x40px pill shape
Task card checkbox 44x44px 18px visual
Task card drag handle 44x52px 16px visual
Send button 44x44px 36px visual
Back arrow 44x44px 18px visual
Bottom sheet drag handle 100x20px 40x4px visual
HUD expand chevron 44x44px 14px visual

Elements smaller than 44px visual size: increase the tap target with transparent padding.

Orientation

  • Portrait only for C3 MVP
  • Add "orientation": "portrait" to PWA manifest
  • Landscape support is a C4 nice-to-have (the isometric view actually looks great in landscape)

Mobile is where clients live. Contractors on job sites, CPAs between meetings. If Corner doesn't work on a phone, it doesn't work. Bobby builds this in Step 10.
